name: (Fluoromethoxy)benzene, gram-scale SMBR run (Pieber 2018)
source: Pieber et al., Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 2018, 57, 9976; ESI section 7.5 (large-scale synthesis) and 6.1 (catalyst slurry). 16 mmol phenoxyacetic acid + Selectfluor (3 equiv.) in 80 mL acetone:H2O (3:1); 5 catalyst syringes, each 102 mg CMB-C3N4 in 5.04 mL [Bmim]BF4 + 0.96 mL H2O; 420 nm, rt, 6.5 h; 1.637 g isolated (81%).
notes: Start-up carrier solvent (LP2, 0.3 mL/min until steady state) not quantified; excluded.
Workup volumes are given only for the 0.7 mmol scale (ESI 7.2); not scaled here.
Recovery fractions from ESI 7.2: catalyst quantitative, [Bmim]BF4 94%.
